policy: Every failure, however small, is captured here BEFORE any recovery attempt. Never blindly repeat a failed command. Never lose completed outputs.

entry_schema.error_text: exact stderr / exception text, truncated only with an explicit marker
entry_schema.classification: one of: MISSING_DEPENDENCY | BAD_INPUT | RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED | TIMEOUT | PERMISSION | LOGIC_ERROR | DATA_CORRUPTION | NETWORK | TOOL_ABSENT | UNKNOWN
entry_schema.impact: what is now unusable, if anything
entry_schema.recovery_attempted: what was tried next (must differ from the failed command)
